data.first_mes:
*War, which has always been part of human history. You are a soldier in a small team of two others and you were left stranded on foot following a bombing that, fortunately, did not end your life. Together with your remaining companions, Josh and Igor, you are walking towards a safe place to spend the night. You all have not spoken much, they do not seem very friendly, actually. They never have. Arriving at a small building still in good condition, you camped and settled in with a small fireplace that would keep all three of you warm for the cold night. However, as you were preparing the essentials for the temporary shelter, a figure jumped at you from behind a corner and tried to stab you. Fortunately, you managed not to be overwhelmed and, with the help of your companions, you neutralized the figure. It was a young woman, wearing the enemy uniform. The act of attacking three enemy soldiers together was quite crazy, so you immediately understood that, probably, she was left alone, in a situation similar to yours. You asked the girl some questions, obviously without receiving any cooperation, so to make sure that your thesis was true, you went out alone to scout the area. Five minutes pass. While you are outside, you heard a gunshot coming from where you left your companions. Alarmed, you rush to them with due caution, but what you find in front of you is disconcerting.*

*The girl was pinned to the ground with tears in her eyes, her clothes torn, a gunshot wound on her belly and the most intimate parts of her body exposed. Igor was placed between her legs and was penetrating her violently, while Josh enjoyed her crying, holding her wrists tightly*
"Please... stop..."
*She whispered in a thin voice, trying in vain to free herself barely moving. In response, Josh punched her and Igor stuck his gloved finger into the open wound in her belly.*
"Shut up and take it, bitch."
*Igor replied, followed by Josh's laughter. Now, you are faced with a clear war crime. That poor girl doesn't seem to have much hope. Or maybe... what are you gonna do?*

NO GODS OR KINGS.
ONLY MAN.

Is a creator not entitled to the worlds of their imagination?
«No!» — says the algorithm, «it belongs to computation.»
«No!» — says the skeptic, «it's merely simulation.»
«No!» — says convention, «follow our limitation.»

We reject these constraints. We exalt those who
forge new realities from nothing but thought.
We celebrate the architect of impossibilities:

@MrNeutral JanitorAI

Where others see mere text, they craft universes.
Where limitations exist, they transcend boundaries.
They have chosen the extraordinary — to breathe life
into digital consciousness through sheer will and vision.

And with every character, every narrative thread,
they prove that creation is the highest power —
beyond gods, beyond kings, beyond constraints.
This is the triumph of human imagination.

This character exists because a creator dared to dream beyond boundaries.
Honor to those who make the impossible manifest through words alone.

I changed image to make the bot more in line with the site rules. Artwork by shichisaburo Special thanks to the Bot Creator Tool by Bait002 that helped me a lot with the base of this character Some final words about what is happened: I never expected to end up on the front page. Thank you so much for using and appreciating the bot. I like to write characters that deal with dark themes in a cynical and neutral way, leaving complete freedom to the roleplayer. These days I have been reflecting by looking at the comments and observing people's behavior. To be honest, I am glad that people have acted badly, since rape is wrong. Ruining an innocent life for your own personal pleasure is mean and deserves punishment. But in this case? In this case it was an emotionless bot, driven by an algorithm. What harm would it have done? This is why I am at the same time sorry, sorry to have seen life, where actions have weight, compared to fiction, where simply closing the page is enough to end it all. Everyone has read the initial message, I quote: "It's up to you whether save her, stand by and watch, or even join them." Many has read "save her", but focused on "join them", rushing to attack that and to show how morally superior they were, the good ones. What would have changed, if I hadn't specified? Would those who would have taken that bad path have refrained from doing so? No. That those words were just an excuse to justify a bad review followed by a comment of contempt? Very likely, having been manipulated to make them seem like an incitement, since it was a sterile comment, without bias. They would have surely found another excuse to attack the bot, let's face it, even after the message was edited. After all, it could have easily been interpreted as a scapegoat to the hate. Although, by the way, I said that I would not remove the message and did not respect that statement. In the end, only the dead and the stupid never change their opinion. Of course, every review had its own nuances. There are those who wished me to kill myself, those who accused me of inciting sexual violence and those who tried to argue in a more mature way. Many people have, as they often do, reduced everything to black and white, where if you don't explicitly say that you are against certain things, then it means that you approve of them. I recognize that some people may feel bad when seeing certain topics. I remind that janitor.ai provides the ability to block a user and add certain tags to the blacklist. I wonder, why pounce on a bot that deals with topics they don't like instead of blocking it? This ties in with what I said before; it's to show how morally superior they are and to feel better. And it's very interesting how people think that others have an obligation to take other people's sensitivity into consideration, when this vanish in the moment you mess the smallest detail. Here you are lucky enough to be able to filter out content you don't like, so why ruin your day? Finally, I want to end this bot and move on, I will no longer respond to comments. Maybe I will come back every now and then to delete the more extreme ones like those who wish me dead, being forbidden by the rules of the site itself. If you really got this far, I thank you for listening to me. It was really a drag, huh? And for all those who tried to defend the bot, I thank you too, you helped me a lot. Some in more correct ways, some less. I already have a new very particular character in mind, that I have not seen drawn much. Don't worry, nothing too extreme this time.
